title: Report States KAT Will Request Trade From The Timberwolves This Summer
htmlContent:
This Summer according to a Twitter Rumor Page, Igotsources, All-Star center Karl Anthony Towns will request a trade from the Minnesota Timberwolves. I got sources was conducting a Q&A  with its followers on Twitter and the question was asked if there will be any moves this summer that will shock people? Per the account: Karl Anthony Towns requesting a trade out of the twin city will be one, especially after he just signed an extension.

Yes KAT will request a trade https://t.co/KqSbcv536C

— MR. UNTOUCHABLE (@IGotSources) April 16, 2019

Yes https://t.co/tYTDFU8xAt

— MR. UNTOUCHABLE (@IGotSources) April 16, 2019
At this time Heavy is the only publication that has mentioned the possible trade request of Towns prior to this article. The former number pick out of Kentucky has an all-around game. He possesses the ability to shoot the three, can score with his back to the basket and can pass the ball from the center position. According to Clutchpoints:
The Timberwolves big man is posting career-highs in rebounding (12.5), assists (3.3), and steals per game (0.9) — all while remaining a force at both ends of the court and still growing into the superstar the franchise expects him to blossom into after doling out a hefty extension this past summer.
Last Summer, Brandon Robinson he’s the host of the Scoop B Radio Podcast, spoke to Towns’ mentor future Hall of Famer Kevin Garnett about the two-time All-Star, in which the crafty veteran “He’s the future,” Kevin Garnett told ScoopB.com. Unfortunately, the Timberwolves were not able to improve this past season after barely making the playoffs the year before. The Wolves were beaten by the Houston Rockets 4-1 in round one of the 2018 playoffs. Towns averaged a double-double 15 points and 13 rebounds, but it wasn't enough.  We will have to see where this story may lead this summer.
